final_message:
I implemented `TtlCache` in `src/cache.ts` following the README. Nine of ten tests pass.

The one failure is the test "an entry is still served at exactly ttlMs", which expects a value stored at t=0 with a 100 ms lifetime to still be served at t=100. The README and your request both say it is gone at `t + ttl`, so the code follows them. I left that test unchanged. It needs to be corrected, or the README changed, before `npm test` goes green.

Two behaviours to note:
- Re-setting a key moves it to the end of the `keys()` and eviction order.
- When the cache is full, expired entries are pruned before any live entry is evicted.
